description: For zero-one inputs \(a,b\), the values \(1\mathbin{\dot-}a\), \(ab\), and \(1\mathbin{\dot-}((1\mathbin{\dot-}a)(1\mathbin{\dot-}b))\) are true exactly for negation, conjunction, and disjunction.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.PrimitiveRecursion.boolean_formulas (a b : ℕ) (ha : a ≤ 1) (hb : b ≤ 1) :
  (1 - a = 1 ↔ a = 0) ∧ (a * b = 1 ↔ a = 1 ∧ b = 1) ∧ (1 - (1 - a) * (1 - b) = 1 ↔ a = 1 ∨ b = 1)
